info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Recordings-v2-spec
info.description: The Meetings Recordings API allows users to access a comprehensive list of recorded meetings. Businesses can utilize this endpoint to retrieve details about meetings that have been recorded, facilitating improved record-keeping and review processes. This API is particularly beneficial for meeting organizers, compliance officers, and team members looking to revisit discussions or presentations. By providing the ability to efficiently list and manage recording resources, the API supports enhanced collaboration and knowledge sharing within organizations.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the recording of a specified meeting. It returns the details of the recording, including playback options and availability.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving meeting recording details. This should include all necessary parameters to specify which recording is being requested.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing, but the processing is not yet complete.
